synthesis.title: Synthesis
synthesis.description: The dialectic engine. Thesis says the evidence is real. Antithesis asks what if we're wrong. Synthesis measures what we actually know. Corollary follows the logic wherever it goes. The investigation's epistemology — the sharpest tools pointed inward.

device.label: Device Crust — The Observer's Viewport

device.orbit_description: The membrane maintains position relative to the observer regardless of device, location, or time. Updates propagate asynchronously via service worker cache-first strategy. The membrane is always facing the user — tidally locked, async-updated.

orbit.description: Geosynchronous Asynchronous Orbit — the membrane maintains stable position relative to the observer (device crust) while data layers rotate and update independently. Like a geostationary satellite that is always above the same point, but its instruments update on their own schedule.

properties.free_floating: membrane anchored to neither server nor device — it floats between two peptidoglycan crusts
properties.orbital_period: session duration — the membrane orbits the user's attention
properties.periapsis: tab focused, chipmunk active, membrane live

crusts.device: viewport boundaries, pixel ratio, orientation — what the user brings
crusts.server: peptidoglycan.json, synthesis.json, fold.json — what the investigation provides

observer.description: The observer's eye moves to the target. Photons don't come to us — we go to them. Each /command is the eye traveling. Each link click is a gaze movement.

gaze.mechanism: the eye moves to the target
gaze.inversion: the back of a star IS a black hole
gaze.implication: non-self sees a black hole because it sees the back. self sees the front because the eye has traveled there.

black_holes.description: Highest-degree non-self entities — the most massive, pulling everything in
black_holes.insight: non-self entities see the membrane as a black hole. they cannot see the structure. 8 entities classified non-self.

pinpricks.description: Tuebor-only nodes with 0 edges in Detroit data — they exist only because tuebor looked at them. Stars at the terminus.
pinpricks.insight: these nodes are created by the act of observation itself. the eye moved to them and they became visible.

permeation.description: tuebor belongs to all above and below it
permeation.insight: tuebor is not one layer. it permeates all layers. its analyses touch evidence (inner), actors (inner), map (outer), and generate new nodes (cytoplasm).

opsonize.name: amicusContra
opsonize.description: The opsonizing intra-layer. Friend of the opposing side. Sits between every peptidoglycan layer as mortar between bricks. Prevents autoimmune response — the system eating itself.
opsonize.position: between all layers — not a layer itself, but the binding agent
opsonize.mechanism: toxin/antidote equilibrium using the same math as fleet classification
